partner_context.their_ambition: You are the Gulf’s commerce and delivery surface — shopping, grocery, food, send, and fast delivery in one consumer app.
partner_context.their_pressure: The UAE’s highest-value customers cluster around marinas, islands, resorts, event venues, and waterfront districts where road movement is often indirect and premium expectations are high.
partner_context.where_navier_fits: Navier gives Noon a marine leg for premium delivery, concierge transfer, event logistics, and experience bundles using sealed network map waterfront geometry rather than a new standalone ferry brand.

hero.title: Noon × Navier — commerce and concierge logistics, now on the water
hero.subtitle: The UAE’s waterfront demand is dense, premium, and app-native. Noon can make the marine leg feel as normal as delivery.
hero.what_we_do_together: Launch a Noon-visible foiling water layer across UAE marina, island, resort, and event districts: premium customer movement, high-value courier hops, hotel/concierge bundles, and experience logistics routed through the same app surface Noon already owns.

why_now: The UAE is concentrating residential, tourism, restaurant, hotel, and event demand on waterfront districts while marine mobility is being actively modernized. Navier adds a fast, smooth, low-noise foiling layer that uses existing water and berth infrastructure, so Noon can extend its app-native convenience from roads to the coast without waiting for new land corridors.

network_thesis.headline: Noon already owns UAE commerce — the waterfront is the premium logistics surface still on roads.
network_thesis.body: Noon runs shopping, grocery, food, and send across the Emirates. Navier extends that app-native convenience to marinas, islands, resorts, and event districts: premium courier hops, concierge transfers, and experience bundles on foiling water legs. The proposal phases cumulative featured corridors on the map — beachhead first, then wider UAE waterfront reach.

revenue_potential.headline: The floor and the prize — every rung traces to grounded, sourced demand.
revenue_potential.modal_lead: We start from grounded corridor demand. Each step adds one realistic expansion lever — network width, induced demand, journey wallet, platform take.
revenue_potential.anchor_note: $159M/yr premium sea-transfer spend on sourced corridors today — the anchor every rung builds from.

whose_money_legend.navier_transport_revenue: Fare the Navier boats collect. This is the corridor P&L (atom.py). SOM/SAM rungs are in this unit.
whose_money_legend.journey_gmv: Total spend on the whole island journey flowing through the super-app: transport + food + stays + experiences + ads + parcel/logistics. Gross, all merchants. TAM rung is in this unit.
whose_money_legend.platform_take: The partner's (Grab's) own commission revenue on journey_gmv. Derived line — this is the number that makes a super-app care, not the boat fare.

revenue_potential.cite_rule: Cite MID. 'High' stacks every optimistic assumption — ceiling, not headline.

ladder_transitions.headline: Same 10% capture, expanded to the full mapped network
ladder_transitions.basis: Width-only step. Capture rate held at 10%; corridor set expands from sourced flagships to the full mapped network.

ladder_transitions.headline: Network matures: faster, more comfortable boats grow the market + leading-operator capture
ladder_transitions.basis: Two-lever step. (1) Faster, more comfortable boats grow the cross-water market (induced demand). (2) Leading-operator capture lifts share from 10% floor to 25% mature, network-wide.

ladder_transitions.headline: Lens shift: Navier captured share → total inducible marine-transfer wallet
ladder_transitions.basis: Unit change. Divide SAM (the captured share) by leading-operator capture rate to recover the full inducible water-transfer market — the marine-mobility TAM.

ladder_transitions.headline: Marine transfer → total journey wallet (food, stays, experiences, in-app ads)
ladder_transitions.basis: Journey-wallet step. Each $1 of marine-transfer spend unlocks ~$3 of broader journey GMV across merchants the partner monetizes.

ladder_transitions.headline: Noon platform take on Navier-carried journeys
ladder_transitions.basis: Platform-take step. Platform commission applied to the journey GMV routed through the Navier network (Navier-captured subset, not the full induced market).
